crossRefs.note: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same king Ahaz.
Don’t you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of the…
I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up…
“Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down…
You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

translations.web: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
translations.bsb: rushing headlong at Him with a thick, studded shield.
translations.kjv: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
translations.asv: He runneth upon him with a stiff neck, With the thick bosses of his bucklers;
